The '''Z-3B''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka Z-3B was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Strategy Alliance Pack.
